name: EDELTEQ
recent: Edelteq 于2026年11月6日完成以1530万令吉收购 Nixma Technology 51% 股权的交易，并通过私募配售发行4300万股新股（发行价0.373令吉）完成集资。公司近期也宣布将逐步退出旧有合约，转向 Halovision 与 Nixma 相关业务。
notable: 完成以1530万令吉收购 Nixma Technology 51% 股权。
私募配售4300万股新股，发行价每股0.373令吉，已于11月3日上市。
公司表示将退出旧有合约，转向 Halovision 与 Nixma 业务。
risks: 私募配售最多10%新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
私募配售发行价0.373令吉较5日成交量加权均价折价约9.93%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收2.861亿令吉，环比增长157.6%，同比增长209.2%；净利462万令吉，环比增长98.8%，同比增长42.7%；净利率1.6%，低于上一季度的2.1%。

recent_en: Edelteq completed its RM15.3 million acquisition of a 51% stake in Nixma Technology on 6 November 2026, and completed a private placement of 43 million new shares at RM0.373 per share. The company also announced it is moving away from legacy contracts and focusing on Halovision and Nixma-related businesses.
notable_en: Completed the RM15.3 million acquisition of a 51% stake in Nixma Technology.
Private placement of 43 million new shares at RM0.373 per share, listed on 3 November.
The company said it is leaving legacy contracts behind and shifting focus to Halovision and Nixma.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% of issued shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Placement price of RM0.373 represented a discount of about 9.93% to the 5-day VWAP.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM286.1 million, up 157.6% QoQ and 209.2% YoY; net income was RM4.62 million, up 98.8% QoQ and 42.7% YoY; net margin was 1.6%, down from 2.1% in the previous quarter.
